<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Cabinet manufacturing schemes:</strong> The Union Cabinet has approved a ₹10,000 crore scheme to establish India as a global container manufacturing hub and an additional ₹1,800 crore initiative for sports goods manufacturing.</li>
  <li><strong>Election controversies:</strong> The Supreme Court has questioned the Election Commission regarding voter notice discrepancies, as political friction continues over MLC election results and alleged voter rigging.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W3</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxNU0t3Y0VjZjBIb0xSTVVJU241ellxdUpBUGxqUGpHalg5UkRZYnpadkVyaDFQVWpyYTZfX2d5UGZXbWZfNXo1VVJZc2kxM2hVN25wM2l0ZTUxek5KNjMyX09yb1V2SlVJbzRsSnJzbVNreXlmTzk1cWNjQ29NLW1hNi1DeklESHZpaDBXZU1aRHJTY0YzekphZA?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W4</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W5</a></span></li>
